provenance.asset_description: Two images overlayed over a blurred background. The top left image is of a wicked weapon of war, a seige engine infused with hellfire, sits atop a wagon. It’s some sort of cannon, but also bristles with strange blades. The bottom right image is of a colorful and cartoonish parade float depicting a happy, wolf-faced sun above a mass of flowers is surrounded by a nimbus of colorful, illusory sparks lights.
